title: Telegraph Resort Campground

services.name: The Forest RV Campground
services.desc: of Telegraph Cove Resort is located one kilometre from the village core, a ten minute stroll up the hill. Nestled in a stand of old growth trees, our campground has over 100 serviced sites available and contains washrooms, showers, firewood and a sani-dump. We welcome tenters and RV’s in our forest campground. Relax by the campfire, or take a short walk on the Bauza Cove trail and explore the ocean shore. There are two small creeks running along either side of the campground and the trailhead to the legendary Dave Farrant Blinkhorn Trail.
